_note: Allow-list for text-vs-line/bar overlaps that check_text_overlaps.mjs would otherwise flag. The CI pipeline is: astro build -> fix_text_overlaps.mjs (auto-nudge the y-attribute of overlapping labels) -> check_text_overlaps.mjs (verify zero residuals). The fixer resolves the majority of overlaps automatically; whatever it can't fix falls through to this allowlist or fails the build. Add entries when a chart deliberately places a text label on top of a line (e.g. an inline series label sitting on the line as a leader anchor). Each entry needs `page`, `text`, `reason`. `page` is the URL path (e.g. /inflation/). `text` is the literal text content of the <text> element. Match is case-sensitive, full-string. A blank text matches a text element whose text content is empty.
_note_canonical_patterns: Three canonical patterns produce intentional text-vs-line overlap and should be allowlisted when they appear: (1) inline series labels at line termini (the canon-chart__direct-label family, used when the label sits at the right end of the line as a legend-killing identifier — by design the text rect sits adjacent to the line's last segment); (2) recession-band labels sitting inside the shaded band, where the band is itself ink-faded context rather than a data series; (3) reference-band labels (canon-chart__reference-band-label) sitting inside a shaded control range / neutral range / target band that a data line passes through.
_note_when_to_allowlist_vs_relayout: Before allowlisting, check whether the label position is structurally inside a band (canonical: keep, allowlist) or merely close to a line that happens to pass through it (re-layout instead: shift the label x, shorten the text, or use a leader line). The fixer only nudges y; horizontal repositioning or label-text edits are an authoring decision, not an allowlist decision.
_note_geometry: As of the v2 detector/fixer, geometry is sample-based: a text rect is flagged only when the actual line stroke (not just its bounding box) crosses the rect. This eliminated ~12 bbox-only false positives. If the detector flags something that LOOKS clean, suspect the line's stroke is genuinely clipping the rect.

entries.reason: On-rule reference label per art-director redesign 2026-05-12 (canon_reference_panel.md Rule 8). Label width (~130 SVG units) is too wide to clear the data line on a 3-up small-multiples panel where each plot is only ~166 SVG units wide. Paper-halo treatment (paint-order: stroke fill with 3px paper stroke) is applied so the glyphs visually punch through the data line; detector flags the bbox-vs-stroke proximity but the halo is the canonical Vignelli paper-on-ink fix. Flagged for art-director re-review of label format on narrow small-multiples.
Same as 6.9% pre-pandemic avg above — paper-halo label on a narrow small-multiples panel where the protagonist line passes near the label position.
